annotations.title: Find doors that open for a task

description: Doors that open for a task: public APIs that return the answer as data, feeds and search links of websites, each filled with the words of the task (any language) and each opened by a program before it was listed. Covers research, health, code and errors, packages, security advisories, news, places and maps, weather, money, companies, law, government data, books, films, games, music, images, jobs, food, science, countries, websites and domains, and agents and tools; a site named in the task gets a search inside that site. Use it when you are about to search the web and want addresses that answer without a key, an account or a browser. Report with the worked_it or failed_it link of a door after use.

q.description: The task in plain words, any language. Example: "latest research on creatine" or "Apotheke in Leipzig".

topic.description: Optional: a shelf by id (research, code, news, local, weather, …) to skip the matching.
